host_about:
Hola !! ... soy Francisco !! estudie ingeniería agrícola y soy máster en derecho, economía y administración agraria. Finalmente me dedico al alquiler vacacional en la ciudad de Valencia.  

Empecé a alquilar mi apartamento a través de Airbnb en el año 2012 y tras más de 6 años como autónomo en esta actividad decidí crear mi propia empresa, una micropyme de carácter familiar que actualmente dirijo.  Desde hace más de 35 años vivo en el centro histórico (Ciutat Vella)  concretamente en el barrio de “El Carmen”. Vivir en éste céntrico barrio me proporciona una calidad de vida que cada día aprecio más, no necesito coger el coche y a píe o en bicicleta todo está bastante cerca. Me gustan las cosas sencillas, disfrutar del sol, de la comida y, de vez en cuando, de una copa de vino. Disfrutar del momento y de las personas a mi alrededor. 

Alguna de las viviendas de uso turístico que alquiló es de mi propiedad y otras no, pero todas ellas han sido reformadas y decorada por mí mismo o bajo mi dirección. Lo he hecho pensando en la comodidad de huéspedes como tú, ofreciendo buena calidad a precios asequibles. 

La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

Estaré encantado de recibirte :))

neighborhood_overview:
La Xerea, nestled within Valencia's historic Old Town ("Ciutat Vella"), offers a unique blend of historical charm and tranquil residential living. This central neighborhood is a veritable treasure trove of Valencia's most iconic landmarks, boasting historic buildings, churches, palaces, and monuments that weave a tapestry of the city's rich heritage.

neighborhood_overview:
El Cabanyal - El Canyamelar is a neighborhood of the city of Valencia (Spain), belonging to the District of maritime towns. It is located at the East side of the city and borders to the North with Malvarrosa, on the East with the Mediterranean Sea, to the Grao to the South and to the West with Ayora, Illa Perduda and Betero. It is an old sailor's neighborhood from the city of Valencia, which between 1837 and 1897 was an independent municipality called New Sea Village (El Poble Nou de la Mar in Valencian). Its peculiar plot in grid derived from alignments of the old barracks parallel to the sea. Mainly fishing village, soon became an area of interest as a place of rest and leisure. Its population is 22.101 inhabitants.
The core of the Cabanal-Cañamelar was declared BIC (Bien de interés Cultural) by the Generalitat Valenciana in 1993. Its unique architecture and its peculiar style (Valencian modernism) make their homes decorated with mosaics and borders of ceramic unique and unrepea

The so-called Casco antiguo of Valencia, i.e. the old city, brings together many fascinating monuments from the Middle Ages, all within walking distance of the apartment.
The Serrano tower, as well as the nearby Torre de Quart, constitute a magnificent example of late 14th century Gothic architecture, while the Plaza de la Virgen, for Valencians Plaza redonda due to the circularity of the buildings that make up its architectural fabric , offers a wonderful show to the visitor who feels immersed in the Gothic-Baroque atmosphere, as in a theater backdrop.
The cathedral, founded on an ancient Roman temple, dates back to the 13th century and combines very different styles. The legend says that here, in a chapel dedicated to it, the holy grail is kept. A spiral staircase leads to a terrace that offers a wonderful view of the city center from above.
The Silk Exchange, an example of civil Gothic architecture, an ancient place of trade, is a delightful and interesting structure

La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

neighborhood_overview:
The history of El Cabanyal spans 700 years.
Personal as well as public projects have now begun to make El Cabanyal into one of the highlights of the city and into a better place to live for its inhabitants.

Between 1880 and 1940, the new Cabanyal exploded with colour and hundreds of houses were built , inspired by the movements of the era – the popular Modernista/Art Nouveau style, with hints of Art Deco and Arts and Crafts. The beautiful tiling of the facades of many of these houses were inspired by the light and the colour of the sea.

During the day, you’ll find vintage thrift shops and small galleries and bookshops, but at night the streets come alive with a buzzing nightlife. Crowds of people pack into the small restaurants, or spill out onto the streets outside the bars and clubs.

Hola !! ... soy Francisco !! estudie ingeniería agrícola y soy máster en derecho, economía y administración agraria. Finalmente me dedico al alquiler vacacional en la ciudad de Valencia.  

Empecé a alquilar mi apartamento a través de Airbnb en el año 2012 y tras más de 6 años como autónomo en esta actividad decidí crear mi propia empresa, una micropyme de carácter familiar que actualmente dirijo.  Desde hace más de 35 años vivo en el centro histórico (Ciutat Vella)  concretamente en el barrio de “El Carmen”. Vivir en éste céntrico barrio me proporciona una calidad de vida que cada día aprecio más, no necesito coger el coche y a píe o en bicicleta todo está bastante cerca. Me gustan las cosas sencillas, disfrutar del sol, de la comida y, de vez en cuando, de una copa de vino. Disfrutar del momento y de las personas a mi alrededor. 

Alguna de las viviendas de uso turístico que alquiló es de mi propiedad y otras no, pero todas ellas han sido reformadas y decorada por mí mismo o bajo mi dirección. Lo he hecho pensando en la comodidad de huéspedes como tú, ofreciendo buena calidad a precios asequibles. 

La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

Estaré encantado de recibirte :))

Ruzafa, a 5-10 minute walk from the Old Town, has a special character, being a village inside a city: it was the first town outside of Valencia before the medieval walls were demolished.
When the expansion of the city took place inthe XIX century , the characteristic orthogonal plots surrounded the neighborhood, leaving it with its intact alleys, and with the traditional town square with its market and church.
The market is one of the attractions of the neighborhood, with fresh products from the Valencian fields, fruits, vegetables, meats and fish from which the restaurants that supply the highest quality raw material are supplied.

The neighborhood has undergone a thorough renovation over the last 15 years, filled with fashionable restaurants, art galleries, vintage product shops and design studios. The traditional wineries, bookstores or leather shops are mixed with the new inhabitants, making the neighborhood a colorful, lively neighborhood that welcomes visitors

Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres.

name: COZY & SUNNY APARTMENT WITH PRIVATE TERRACE
description: Apartment with a private terrace where you can have breakfast, sunbathe or dine under the Valencia moon. This home is in Ruzafa, Valencia's trendy neighborhood. It allows you to reach the historic center in a 10-minute walk. In this neighborhood, the tradition of the local market converges with avant-garde restaurants and taverns, jazz cafes, good bookstores, and artists' workshops. This diversity gives the neighborhood an eclectic and bohemian air like the spirit of our apartment.
neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood's focal point is the Ruzafa market and the mid-18th century Baroque-style San Valero bell tower. We recommend La Petrona for tapas in front of this bell tower.
Ruzafa is one of the traditional neighborhoods of Las Fallas. Its most popular monuments are on Sueca, Literato Azorín, and Cuba streets.
The Bartleby Bookstore on Calle Cadíz 50 is one of the most interesting bookstores in the entire city. It presents the latest editorial releases with the authors and showcases the city's best illustrators.
The Central Park is a project designed by American landscape architect Kathryn Gustafson and connects the neighborhood of Ruzafa with Malilla. It is one of the most spectacular landscaped spaces of the moment and has a network of water trails, trees, a climbing wall and the rehabilitation of the railway warehouses of Demetrio Ribes, one of the most relevant Valencian architects of the early twentieth century.

Pinedo is a small, quiet village 5 km from Valencia. It is located in the heart of the Albufera Natural Park, surrounded by rice fields and other crops and with a dune area on the beach. It has almost 3 km of beach (including a nudist area), and a bike path that connects downtown Valencia with Pinedo and El Saler. Its beaches are considered of great beauty due to their proximity to the orchards, their extensive dunes and their wild character unlike other beaches in Valencia
The district has all the services: supermarkets, bakery, restaurants, bars, hairdresser, tobacconist, medical center, pharmacy, parks for children, bank, church, mechanic, greengrocer, dentist... and you also have a Shopping Center 5 minutes away by car (10 by bus).

neighborhood_overview:
El Cabanyal is a historic and picturesque neighborhood in Valencia that became an independent municipality in the 19th century, under the name of Pueblo Nuevo del Mar. Even today it is a fishermen's neighborhood, the protagonist of the most traditional images, where life has another rhythm.
Its architectural value is immeasurable. In Cabanyal, there are shacks, fishermen's cottages, tiled façades, colorful buildings, and modernist structures. From the Lonja de Pescadores (Fishermen's Market) to the Mercado del Grao (market); passing by the houses on the streets of La Reina, Escalante or José Benlliure. The unique layout of its buildings and the arrangement of its urban planning are also responsible for a very authentic social climate and lifestyle, almost extinct in large metropolises.

It is also known for its rich cuisine and curious traditions, such as the Seafaring Holy Week and its numerous activities and festivals during the summer.

Hola !! ... soy Francisco !! estudie ingeniería agrícola y soy máster en derecho, economía y administración agraria. Finalmente me dedico al alquiler vacacional en la ciudad de Valencia.  

Empecé a alquilar mi apartamento a través de Airbnb en el año 2012 y tras más de 6 años como autónomo en esta actividad decidí crear mi propia empresa, una micropyme de carácter familiar que actualmente dirijo.  Desde hace más de 35 años vivo en el centro histórico (Ciutat Vella)  concretamente en el barrio de “El Carmen”. Vivir en éste céntrico barrio me proporciona una calidad de vida que cada día aprecio más, no necesito coger el coche y a píe o en bicicleta todo está bastante cerca. Me gustan las cosas sencillas, disfrutar del sol, de la comida y, de vez en cuando, de una copa de vino. Disfrutar del momento y de las personas a mi alrededor. 

Alguna de las viviendas de uso turístico que alquiló es de mi propiedad y otras no, pero todas ellas han sido reformadas y decorada por mí mismo o bajo mi dirección. Lo he hecho pensando en la comodidad de huéspedes como tú, ofreciendo buena calidad a precios asequibles. 

La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

Estaré encantado de recibirte :))

Hola !! ... soy Francisco !! estudie ingeniería agrícola y soy máster en derecho, economía y administración agraria. Finalmente me dedico al alquiler vacacional en la ciudad de Valencia.  

Empecé a alquilar mi apartamento a través de Airbnb en el año 2012 y tras más de 6 años como autónomo en esta actividad decidí crear mi propia empresa, una micropyme de carácter familiar que actualmente dirijo.  Desde hace más de 35 años vivo en el centro histórico (Ciutat Vella)  concretamente en el barrio de “El Carmen”. La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

Estaré encantado de recibirte :))

host_about:
Hola !! ... soy Francisco !! estudie ingeniería agrícola y soy máster en derecho, economía y administración agraria. Finalmente me dedico al alquiler vacacional en la ciudad de Valencia.  

Empecé a alquilar mi apartamento a través de Airbnb en el año 2012 y tras más de 6 años como autónomo en esta actividad decidí crear mi propia empresa, una micropyme de carácter familiar que actualmente dirijo.  Desde hace más de 35 años vivo en el centro histórico (Ciutat Vella)  concretamente en el barrio de “El Carmen”. Vivir en éste céntrico barrio me proporciona una calidad de vida que cada día aprecio más, no necesito coger el coche y a píe o en bicicleta todo está bastante cerca. Me gustan las cosas sencillas, disfrutar del sol, de la comida y, de vez en cuando, de una copa de vino. Disfrutar del momento y de las personas a mi alrededor. 

Alguna de las viviendas de uso turístico que alquiló es de mi propiedad y otras no, pero todas ellas han sido reformadas y decorada por mí mismo o bajo mi dirección. Lo he hecho pensando en la comodidad de huéspedes como tú, ofreciendo buena calidad a precios asequibles. 

La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

Estaré encantado de recibirte :))

At the moment there are powerful remains of art, culture, traditions based on former Valencian's way of living. To me this is one of the most autentic spots in Valencia.

neighborhood_overview:
The Barrio del Carmen (neighborhood) built around the Plaza del Carmen, takes you back to the history of ancient Valencia. This neighborhood grew with two walls, one built in the 11th century by Muslims on the east side, and another by Christians in the 14th century, which made the place the main point of entry and exit from Valencia.

The Carmen neighborhood has seen centuries of history. It has been an orchard, suburb and Muslim refuge, brothel, guild settlement, home of the medieval aristocracy, place of convents, proletarian-marginal area during the Industrial Revolution and, at the end of the 20th century, a leisure space for the city's youth.

The most outstanding landmark buildings in El Carmen are:

Quart Towers

Serranos Towers

IVAM (Valencian Institute of Modern Art)

La Beneficencia Cultural Center (Museum of Prehistory of Valencia and Valencian Museum of Ethnology)

19th Century Museum

Portal

Bar Alhambra, on Calle Calixto III, makes the best potato omelettes with many flavors.

host_about:
Hola !! ... soy Francisco !! estudie ingeniería agrícola y soy máster en derecho, economía y administración agraria. Finalmente me dedico al alquiler vacacional en la ciudad de Valencia.  

Empecé a alquilar mi apartamento a través de Airbnb en el año 2012 y tras más de 6 años como autónomo en esta actividad decidí crear mi propia empresa, una micropyme de carácter familiar que actualmente dirijo.  Desde hace más de 35 años vivo en el centro histórico (Ciutat Vella)  concretamente en el barrio de “El Carmen”. Vivir en éste céntrico barrio me proporciona una calidad de vida que cada día aprecio más, no necesito coger el coche y a píe o en bicicleta todo está bastante cerca. Me gustan las cosas sencillas, disfrutar del sol, de la comida y, de vez en cuando, de una copa de vino. Disfrutar del momento y de las personas a mi alrededor. 

Alguna de las viviendas de uso turístico que alquiló es de mi propiedad y otras no, pero todas ellas han sido reformadas y decorada por mí mismo o bajo mi dirección. Lo he hecho pensando en la comodidad de huéspedes como tú, ofreciendo buena calidad a precios asequibles. 

La vivienda de uso turístico es una modalidad de alojamiento de carácter exclusivamente residencial y en ella no se ofrecen servicios propios de la industria hotelera. Espero de las personas que hagan uso de esta modalidad de alojamiento presten especial atención por el respeto al descanso de los vecinos cercanos, las normas de la comunidad de propietarios y la idiosincrasia de nuestros barrios y costumbres. 

Espero y deseo que disfrutes mucho de tu experiencia en la ciudad de Valencia.

Estaré encantado de recibirte :))

A tour of the Petxina neighborhood.
The undisputed king of the neighborhood is Bar Ricardo, which opened in 1947… 70 years ago! Ricardo is one of those tapas bars and Valencian cuisine, whose secret is none other than good product, simple preparation and professional treatment. Its bar, along with Rausell, is one of the best in the city, and its tables are the most coveted.
Bar Alhambra, on Calle Calixto III, makes the best potato omelettes with many flavors.
Opposite is Umami, a restaurant with a simple but very tasty menu. Fresh fish from the Lonja every day.

In La Petxina, apart from eating, people also stay up late, drink and dance. Maybe next time you go to a concert at the Loco Club, which shares a street with Umami and the Alhambra bar, you can have dinner at one of these restaurants.

Located in the maritime neighborhood of Cabañal, founded by fishermen in the 19th century. XIX and composed of narrow and long streets of low buildings parallel to the Port of Valencia and the sea and frequently portrayed by the painter Sorolla and the writer Blasco Ibañez. This is an emblematic neighborhood, especially now, because it is undergoing a comprehensive rehabilitation of facades and interiors after having been deteriorated in previous decades. Its resurgence has turned it into a lively area in terms of leisure and culture, it is the currently fashionable neighborhood, due to the social awareness that the importance of the traditional and the authentic has generated. With the reopening of the Musical Theater and La Fábrica de Hielo, Valencia's newest cultural offering has its epicenter in El Cabañal. In terms of gastronomy, this is a neighborhood of homemade food and seafood, as well as highly valued places to go for beers and tapas.

name: Dúplex en el Cabañal, Valencia, cerca del mar.
description:
Cozy duplex with sunny terrace, a 5-minute walk to Las Arenas beach and its promenade. Located on a quiet street in the bohemian Cabanyal neighborhood, very well connected to enjoy the beautiful city of Valencia. All services at hand: bike rental, bars, restaurants, supermarkets, ice cream parlors, shops and even a Flamenco dance hall.
Rental regulated by Law 29/1994 on Urban Leases, with the signing of a SEASONAL LEASE AGREEMENT.
neighborhood_overview:
Considered a Site of Cultural Interest (BIC), El Cabanyal is distinguished by its Modernist style, adapted to the authentic taste of its former residents.

It's a quiet and safe neighborhood. We know this because we live there. It's easy to live in and has everything you need. We love its atmosphere, its rich urban art, the festivals and cultural events it hosts all year round, and the multiculturalism of its residents. We're not surprised that The Guardian newspaper included it among Europe's ten coolest neighborhoods in 2020.

The duplex is a 5-minute walk from Las Arenas del Cabanyal beach, the central hub of about 3 kilometers of white sand, where it is common to see people practicing sailing, surfing, kitesurfing, kayaking, volleyball and soccer, among others. For water sports, the Marina de Valencia offers equipment for rent.

The promenade is a dynamic meeting point, with a lively atmosphere and a varied gastronomic and leisure offer.

Ruzafa, a 5-10 minute walk from the Old Town, has a special character, being a village inside a city: it was the first town outside of Valencia before the medieval walls were demolished.
When the expansion of the city took place inthe XIX century , the characteristic orthogonal plots surrounded the neighborhood, leaving it with its intact alleys, and with the traditional town square with its market and church.
The market is one of the attractions of the neighborhood, with fresh products from the Valencian fields, fruits, vegetables, meats and fish from which the restaurants that supply the highest quality raw material are supplied.

The neighborhood has undergone a thorough renovation over the last 15 years, filled with fashionable restaurants, art galleries, vintage product shops and design studios. neighborhood_overview:
Malvarrosa beach, located north of the Port of Valencia, offers its visitors 3 kilometers of coastline with fine, golden sand. This area was formerly occupied by fishermen, later it was a resting place for the Valencian bourgeoisie and currently maintains its charm as a modern area of the city, in the midst of a renovation phase. As a curiosity, it was named after its plantation of aromatic herbs and pinkish mallows. It is perfect if you want to go with your family or to sunbathe in a relaxed way, but it is also great if you want to practice some sport in front of the sea, since there are areas specially set up for the most active.

100 meters from the apartment there are all kinds of services and leisure facilities, supermarkets, trendy restaurants, hammocks on the beach, beach volleyball facilities, the museum of the Valencian writer Vicente Blasco Ibáñez... Valencia is a vibrant city full of history and culture that will not leave you indifferent!

Its architectural value is immeasurable. In the Cabanyal there are barracks, fishermen's cottages, tiled facades, colorful buildings and modernist structures. From La Lonja de Pescadores to Mercado del Grao; passing through the houses of the street of Sant Pere, La Reina or Escalant; and even the area of Progrés and Amparo Guillem. The particular plan of its buildings and the layout of its urbanism (the alleys are almost a labyrinth) are also responsible for a social climate and a very authentic lifestyle, almost extinct in the large metropolises.

neighborhood_overview:
Located in the maritime neighbourhood of Cabañal, founded by fishermen in the 19th century and made up of narrow, long streets of low buildings parallel to the Port of Valencia and the sea and frequently portrayed by the painter Sorolla and the writer Blasco Ibañez. This is an emblematic neighbourhood, especially now, because it is undergoing a comprehensive rehabilitation of its facades and interiors after having been deteriorated in previous decades. Its resurgence has turned it into a lively area in terms of leisure and culture, it is the trendy neighbourhood at present, due to the social awareness that has generated the importance of the traditional and the authentic. With the reopening of the Musical Theatre and La Fábrica de Hielo, the most innovative cultural offering in Valencia has its epicentre in El Cabañal. In terms of gastronomy, this is a neighbourhood of home-made food and seafood, as well as highly valued places to go for beers and tapas.

Relax in this quiet, spacious and comfortable house, located in Valencia in the heart of the Nazaret neighborhood, next to the Cabañal, forming "the Maritime Villages" 5 meters walk from the Port and 20 to the beaches. Metro and buses 2 meters away
that will take you on short trips to the City of Sciences, Historic Center, Beaches ... Market, supermarket, shops 1 minute away. Enjoy renting bikes and being able to store them on your return. Spacious rooms, 2 bathrooms and privacy will make your days easier.
neighborhood_overview: The neighborhood is one of the neighborhoods that form the Maritime Poblados of Valencia, in full expansion, active during the day and neighborhood of rest for the night ,  where you can find in the opposite directions the beaches closest to Valencia, on one side Puerto, Playa de las Arenas, Playa del Cabañal, Playa s la Malvarrosa and Playa de la Patacona and on the opposite side Playa de Pinedo, Playa del Saler and Albufera  , Valencia Natural Park. It is also very close to the Old River Turia channel, City of Sciences , Oceanographic and Shopping Center of Saler, Aqua  and Corte Inglés shopping center.
host_about:
Soy Eva, una chica muy sencilla , me encanta cuidar los detalles y que se puedan cumplir todas las necesidades de los que me rodean.
Disfruto de las grandes caminatas , escursiones en bici, aire libre y naturaleza, por todos estos motivos adoro mi ciudad  Valencia, con su extenso paseo marítimo, el puerto, el Saler, gran parque natural con La Albufera y sus atardeceres, un cauce del río Turia, todo ajardinado y cuidado que es maravilloso para caminarlo y circularlo en bici, adaptado para subir a cualquier parte de la ciudad, empezando en la Ciudad de las Ciencias y terminando en el parque de Cabecera, donde encontramos nuestro Bioparc!!

The district is divided into several neighborhoods, including El Carmen, known for its lively atmosphere, street art, and nightlife. Ciutat Vella also features remnants of the old city walls, such as the Torres de Serranos and Torres de Quart, which once protected the city.
